newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up in post-budget session.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up in post-budget session.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Saturday, a day after the 1997/98 budget, which exempted from wealth tax 50 percent of investments in equities, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The KSE allowed computerised trading on Saturday, usually a holiday, but did not immediately update its 100-share index or its tally of rising and falling scrips.
Dealers said the wealth tax exemption and tax relief for the cement sector prompted fresh buying and prices closed higher.
Pakistan Telecom rose 0.85 rupee to 30.40 at the close at 13.33 p.m. (0833 GMT). -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
